resources.string: A Multimodal AI System for Pre-Action Risk Detection in Everyday Digital Tasks

ContextGuard uses Android Accessibility APIs strictly as a pre-action digital safety assistant to inspect allowlisted app screens for phishing links, credential hazards, and data leakage before actions are committed. This service is an AI security monitor, not an assistive tool for users with disabilities.
User-controlled on-device domain evaluation. Only visible destination hostnames are evaluated locally; HTTPS web pages, passwords, and encrypted payloads are never decrypted or inspected.

ContextGuard evaluates destination hostnames on-device to flag known phishing domains. Requires Android VPN authorization. This is completely separate from offline analysis mode. ContextGuard never forwards traffic to external servers or breaks device connectivity.
